class.name: PhysX
class.brief_description: Script access to the PhysX physics backend: GPU queries and active-ragdoll joint drives.
class.description: Static queries about the PhysX backend as a whole, for a game that adapts to the machine it runs on, e.g. choosing [PhysXParticleFluid3D]'s solver or how much debris to spawn: [codeblock] if PhysX.is_gpu_available(): print("GPU physics on ", PhysX.get_gpu_device_name()) [/codeblock] It also carries the joint drives Godot's joint API has no room for, the ones an active ragdoll needs: a SLERP drive, acceleration drives, spring force limits and a drive target set in one call. They take a joint's [RID] ([method Joint3D.get_rid], or [method physical_bone_get_joint] for a [PhysicalBone3D]) and work on pin, hinge, cone twist and Generic6DOF joints. Like other physics server calls they may be made at any time, also with [member ProjectSettings.physics/3d/run_on_separate_thread] on; a getter then waits for the physics thread.

method.name: get_gpu_device_name
method.description: Returns the name of the CUDA device GPU dynamics runs on (for example [code]"NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070"[/code]), or an empty string when [method is_gpu_available] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: is_gpu_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when PhysX is the active physics engine and is running GPU dynamics on a CUDA device. It is [code]false[/code] in a build without GPU support, on a machine without a usable NVIDIA GPU or without [code]PhysXGpu[/code] shipped next to the executable, with [code]physics/physx_3d/simulation/enhanced_determinism[/code] on or [code]physics/physx_3d/simulation/gpu_dynamics[/code] off, or when another physics engine is selected. Without it, GPU-only features fall back or stay inert: [PhysXParticleFluid3D] with the PBD solver, GPU cloth and so on. Valid once the physics server has started (from any node's [code]_ready[/code] on).

method.name: joint_get_angular_spring_torque_limit
method.description: Returns the torque limit of the Generic6DOF joint's angular spring about [param axis] (see [method joint_set_angular_spring_torque_limit]).

method.name: joint_get_drive_target
method.description: Returns the pose the joint's drives pull toward (see [method joint_set_drive_target]); until one is set, the pose a Generic6DOF joint's spring equilibrium points make.

method.name: joint_get_linear_spring_force_limit
method.description: Returns the force limit of the Generic6DOF joint's linear spring along [param axis] (see [method joint_set_linear_spring_force_limit]).

method.name: joint_is_drive_acceleration
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the joint's drives are acceleration drives (see [method joint_set_drive_acceleration]).

method.name: joint_is_slerp_drive_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the joint's SLERP drive is on (see [method joint_set_slerp_drive]).

method.name: joint_set_angular_spring_torque_limit
method.description: Sets the most torque (N m) the Generic6DOF joint's angular spring about [param axis] may apply, so a stiff spring can't snap a bone around. [code]INF[/code] (the default) or a negative value is no limit. The SLERP drive has its own limit (see [method joint_set_slerp_drive]).

method.name: joint_set_drive_acceleration
method.description: If [code]true[/code], the joint's spring stiffness and damping (the 6DOF springs and the SLERP drive) are accelerations rather than forces: the same gains turn a light and a heavy body alike, so one set suits every bone of a ragdoll. It only counts the two bodies at the joint, though: a joint that carries more of the body (a spine under the torso) needs its stiffness scaled up by about the mass it carries over its own bone's. Motors keep their force units.

method.name: joint_set_drive_target
method.description: Sets the pose the joint's drives pull toward: body B's joint frame relative to body A's (identity is the pose the joint was made in). The rotation is what [method joint_set_slerp_drive] and the 6DOF angular springs turn toward, the origin where the 6DOF linear springs pull. Only the target moves, nothing else about the joint is rewritten, so it's cheap enough to call for every bone every physics frame. It replaces a Generic6DOF joint's spring equilibrium points until one of those is changed. With [param delta] above zero, the time since the previous target (the physics frame's delta when it's set every frame), the drives also move at the target's own velocity, worked out from the two targets: the drive's damping then holds the body to the moving target rather than toward standing still, so it follows an animation instead of trailing it. A running motor keeps its axis. Without [param delta] the target's velocity is zero.

method.name: joint_set_drive_target_from_poses
method.description: Sets the drive target (see [method joint_set_drive_target], also for [param delta]) that puts body A at global transform [param pose_a] and body B at [param pose_b], without needing the joint's frames. Only the two poses relative to each other matter, so poses in any common space do, e.g. a skeleton's bone poses. For a [PhysicalBone3D] the body sits at its bone's pose times [member PhysicalBone3D.body_offset]: [codeblock] var joint := PhysX.physical_bone_get_joint(bone) PhysX.joint_set_drive_target_from_poses(joint, animated.get_bone_global_pose(parent.get_bone_id()) * parent.body_offset, animated.get_bone_global_pose(bone.get_bone_id()) * bone.body_offset, delta) [/codeblock]

method.name: joint_set_linear_spring_force_limit
method.description: Sets the most force (N) the Generic6DOF joint's linear spring along [param axis] may apply. [code]INF[/code] (the default) or a negative value is no limit. A linear motor on the same axis uses its own force limit.

method.name: joint_set_slerp_drive
method.description: Turns the joint's SLERP drive on or off: one spring that turns body B toward the drive target's rotation (see [method joint_set_drive_target]) along the shortest path, all three angles at once, with [param stiffness] (N m per radian), [param damping] (N m s per radian) and at most [param torque_limit] (N m). It replaces a Generic6DOF joint's per-axis angular springs and motors while on, and works within the joint's angular limits; a 6DOF axis without a valid limit range is freed, as for its springs. On a hinge it drives the hinge angle: the hinge is rebuilt as a PhysX D6 joint the first time, with the same limits and motor.

method.name: physical_bone_get_joint
method.description: Returns the RID of the joint between [param bone] and its parent bone, for the [code]joint_*[/code] drive calls. Empty for a bone without one: the root bone, or [constant PhysicalBone3D.JOINT_TYPE_NONE]. The joint exists once the bone is in the tree; the RID stays the same, and keeps its drive settings, when the bone's joint properties change.
